name: pi-subagents
notes: Forked from nicobailon/pi-subagents; local compatibility fixes preserve @xzzpig/pi-permission-system priority in resolvePermissionSystemExtension() (now in src/runs/shared/child-tool-plan.ts). Fleet native transcript (openspec fleet-native-transcript): src/tui/fleet-native-transcript.ts (JSONL→shared-library entries adapter + Pi-native renderer via guarded dynamic import of @xzzpig/pi-components/transcript), wiring in src/tui/fleet.ts (renderer mode cache branch, v/V toggleRenderer keybinding, legacy fallback), @xzzpig/pi-components bundled via bundledDependencies (private, never published), and shared readTranscriptRecords export in src/tui/fleet-transcript.ts. Fork-only additions: context injection (src/extension/context-injection.ts, injectToContext frontmatter field, subagents.injectAgents setting, doctor reporting) and the shared agent-eject API (src/api/agent-management.ts, ejectAgentDefinition) used by pi-goal-x. The old Pi SDK streamFn option-naming divergence was dropped: upstream ships agentStreamOptions() dual-name handling. v0.68.0 sync adopted upstream's removal of fallbackModels / same-launch model switching / persistent model exclusions (do not re-port the fork's multi-model loop onto execution.ts or subagent-runner.ts), upstream's herdr pane-native placement plus the src/inspectors/herdr collapse, and upstream's createCapturedChildHooks / buildRunnerChildLaunch / resolveLaunchBinding architecture; the fork's sandbox-profile and permission-profile threading (RunnerSubagentStep.sandbox/permissionProfile, LaunchBindingSource fields, resolveSandboxExtension, preflight untrusted_project validation) must be re-applied on each future sync. Known accepted lint debt after the v0.68.0 sync: pi-lens reports ~72 blocking findings across ~40 files dominated by no-unknown-returns, require-safety-comment-for-as-unknown-as, unchecked-throwing-call, and error-swallowing on upstream-original code, plus known false positives (TS1470 import.meta on ESM sources, Vite-style query-string imports in async-spawn-package-dir.test.ts); by decision on 2026-09-17 the fork keeps upstream code byte-identical instead of adding per-site inline suppressions, so the findings are recorded as accepted debt and re-checked on the next sync rather than fixed in-tree. 2026-09-19 conflict-surface pass: eject implementation moved from src/agents/agent-management.ts to fork-only src/agents/agent-eject.ts (agent-management.ts now exports sanitizeName/availableAgentNames/nameExistsInScope for it, handleEject delegates unchanged, src/api/agent-management.ts re-exports from agent-eject.ts). Fork-appended test blocks moved out of the upstream test files into fork-only test/unit/fork-*.test.ts (agent-frontmatter, child-tool-plan-profiles, fleet, preflight, doctor); agent-frontmatter/child-tool-plan-permission-system/fleet/preflight/doctor test files are byte-identical to upstream again. The profile-name validation try/catch copies were replaced by validateSandboxProfileNameOptional/validatePermissionProfileNameOptional in src/shared/{sandbox,permission}-profile.ts, and the six project-trust error copies merged into projectScopedProfileTrustError in src/runs/shared/sandbox-profile-guard.ts (all error messages byte-identical). Fork doc chapters moved to docs/fork-extensions.md (agents.md keeps only its 8 necessary inline lines, extension-api.md keeps the @xzzpig renames, README anchor updated). Pi 0.85.1 host-compat cluster is fork-necessary and recorded for future syncs: tool-result dedup in src/runs/foreground/execution.ts (message_end role=toolResult vs tool_result_end dual channel), modelRegistry.refresh shape compat, devDeps bump to 0.85.1. .oxlintrc.json overrides intentionally stay broad: narrowing them re-enables ~11k anti-slop errors across ~436 upstream files that upstream never satisfied; accepted debt. Known pre-existing test failures (verified present at the upstream-anchored baseline): 'copies a package agent that shadows a builtin by runtime precedence', 'also disables a package agent via a settings override', 'prunes repo internals and nested project roots from broad package discovery', 'preserves canonical contact_supervisor progress and structured-interview semantics'. 2026-09-19 P2 pass: resolveSandboxExtension and the sandbox/permission-profile decision inside resolvePiLaunchToolPlan moved to fork-only src/runs/shared/profile-extensions.ts (resolveProfileExtensions; error strings byte-identical), and the profile launch-env construction in buildInProcessChildLaunch moved to fork-only src/runs/shared/profile-launch-env.ts (buildProfileLaunchEnv); child-tool-plan.ts and child-launch.ts keep only seams (imports, input fields, one call each). SANDBOX_PROFILE_GUARD_EXTENSION_PATH stays in child-tool-plan.ts to avoid a TDZ-prone cycle.
